result.description: Close is a CRM for sales teams: leads, contacts, opportunities, calling, email/SMS and workflow automation.
result.auth_detail: OAuth2 authorization-code with refresh tokens, for user-facing apps (create an OAuth app in Close settings). API key sent via HTTP Basic (key as username, empty password), per user/org.
result.access_detail: No free plan. Signup gives a 14-day free trial with no card. Keys and OAuth apps are self-serve in Settings → Developer. The pricing FAQ says Close provides a REST API with no published API quota or API fees, and does not mark the API as plan-restricted. An ongoing paid subscription is needed after the trial. No app review is documented for OAuth apps.
result.api_notes: REST at api.close.com/api/v1. Covers leads, contacts, opportunities, activities (calls, email, SMS, notes, meetings), custom fields, and more. Has pagination, a _fields parameter and rate limits. Composio lists 109 tools for the Close MCP. Webhooks exist but were not verified here.
result.blocker: No permanent free tier: dev testing needs the 14-day trial or a paid seat. Otherwise none.

evidence.quote: API keys use [HTTP Basic client side authentication](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Basic_access_authentication#Client_side).
14-day free trial, no credit card required
Yes. Close provides a REST API for building custom integrations, connecting your applications, and automating sales processes.
Close uses industry-standard REST conventions with predictable URL structures, standard HTTP methods, and JSON request/response bodies.
The MCP server URL is `https://mcp.close.com/mcp` and has "HTTP Streamable" and "OAuth 2.0 Dynamic Client Registration (DCR)" support.
To implement authentication with OAuth 2.0, you need to [create an OAuth app](/integrations/create-an-oauth-app) to get your **Client ID** and **Client Secret**.
